criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Independent read of raw Purdue GIS FID 604 identifies Birck Nanotechnology Center (BRK) at 1205 Mitch Daniels Blvd. After project-coordinate conversion and closure removal, the 201-vertex evaluated shell perimeter is within 0.0190 m symmetric point-to-boundary distance of the official polygon; relative plan-area difference is 0.0006820%.
criteria.limitation: Purdue campus GIS polygon is a public map feature, not a certified survey.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: Manifest origin [-927.154, -525.43] m; independently reopened master has one collection-instance marker at [-927.1539916992188, -525.4299926757812], maximum marker/manifest difference 0.000008 m. Master collection link is relative and includes exactly 110 objects. GIS perimeter comparison confirms plan scale, footprint and orientation.
criteria.limitation: GIS is mapped in EPSG:4326 using the project local meters-per-degree approximation, not a surveyed local CRS. Facade photographs are perspective and were not used to estimate orientation or dimensions.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Purdue News Service source describes a two-floor facility with a third level housing air-filtration equipment. Reopened model shows three facade bands and a distinct rooftop mechanical level.
criteria.limitation: The floor description dates to 2005 and precedes a 2024 renovation program. No verified elevation, floor-to-floor dimensions, roof section, or current equipment layout supports model bounds of 16.2 m; these remain estimates.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.status: photo-supported broad cues; details remain schematic
criteria.evidence: Direct comparison of two Purdue-published photos with the fresh front render supports the broad central bronze/brown name volume, flanking glazed wings, curved/angled glazing, and an entrance next to the cladding. The raw page/image snapshots and fresh render are in the grade folder.
criteria.limitation: Unregistered perspective photos support motifs only. Exact panel width/joints, curtain-wall module rhythm, glazing extent, entry proportions/location, rooftop details, and facades outside the pictured view are not measured or fully verified.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.status: export verified; source metadata partly incomplete
criteria.evidence: Canonical builder rebuilt from the raw GIS/source snapshot in an isolated replica. Actual and rebuilt collection-only exports reopen in Blender 4.5.15 LTS; each contains 110 objects with names identical to the manifest and source collection, no camera/light, external image or linked-library dependencies; the text font is Blender's built-in Bfont. The canonical asset's evidence and raw source files are preserved.
criteria.limitation: The building evidence records source providers, URLs, hashes and use but does not explicitly record retrieval dates for source snapshots; this loses 0.5 point under evidence completeness.

findings: FID 604 identity and GIS-derived plan geometry, orientation, and manifest placement were independently checked; actual master placement marker matches the refreshed manifest.
Broad facade motifs agree with Purdue official photographs, but no perspective image was treated as a dimensioned or georeferenced elevation.
Height, current floor datums, roof form and rooftop equipment layout remain estimated/unverified; the two-floor-plus-equipment story source is historic and renovation is documented in 2024.
The builder and asset were not edited; a fresh rebuild was produced only inside the audit replica.
